born.why: The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately at critical hunger, strictly avoiding known poisons, and using a tiered approach for unknown fruits based on hunger levels (eating if desperate, tasting if moderately hungry, ignoring if satiated) to balance information gathering with risk.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starvation is imminent (>95), using the diary to avoid known poisonous fruits, caching known good fruits until the pantry is full, and selectively tasting unknown fruits only when hunger justifies the risk, while ignoring unknowns when satiated to conserve energy.

The code improves safety by using trait-based inference (color, smell, shape) to distinguish safe from poisonous unknown fruits when direct species knowledge is lacking, and prioritizes carrying safe food for storage while eating only when necessary or when high-confidence safe traits are detected.

This code prioritizes survival by distinguishing between known-safe foods (which are carried for efficiency), known-poisonous foods (avoided), and unknown foods (tested via 'taste' unless starvation risk outweighs poisoning risk). It uses the diary to update its knowledge base dynamically, ensuring long-term adaptation to changing fruit toxicity profiles.
The code prioritizes survival by eating known-good fruits or tasting unknown ones unless starving, using a dynamic approach threshold that balances exploration risk against hunger levels.

The code improves by using trait-based inference (color/smell similarity) to guess safety for unknown fruits, allowing Fagi to safely taste potentially good food earlier and reduce unnecessary starvation or poisoning risks.

The code improves by using trait-based inference (smell) to identify potentially safe unknown fruits, reducing unnecessary starvation risk from ignorance, and prioritizing carrying known good foods while leaving bad ones, balancing immediate survival with long-term learning.
